dev_link.description: Only when APP_ENV=local, so no email server is needed.

heartbeats_available.title: Heartbeats Available
heartbeats_available.description: False when Redis could not be read

mismatch.title: Mismatch
mismatch.description: A service reports a profile other than the API's

daily.title: Daily
daily.description: Events per day over the last 14 days, oldest first

sparkline.title: Sparkline
sparkline.description: Events per hour over the last 24 hours, oldest first

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: Last change: gap updated_at, session end

updated_by.title: Updated By
updated_by.description: Admin email of the last change; None: never set

values.description: The value in force for every key

spend_today_usd.title: Spend Today Usd
spend_today_usd.description: OC-3: model cost since UTC midnight (30 s cache)

cap_pct.title: Cap Pct
cap_pct.description: Today's cost / the cap, as a fraction

own_questions.title: Own Questions
own_questions.description: Scores from the candidate's own questions.

OwnQuestionPoint.title: OwnQuestionPoint
OwnQuestionPoint.description:
CU-7: a snapshot of a Custom session that comes (partly) from the candidate's own
questions.

age_confirmed.title: Age Confirmed
age_confirmed.description: The user confirmed they are 18 or older.

training_consent.title: Training Consent
training_consent.description: AC-2: off unless the user opts in.

Phase.title: Phase

PhaseTime.description: Minutes planned for one phase of the session (IV-7).
PhaseTime.title: PhaseTime

free_interviews.title: Free Interviews
free_interviews.description: BL-2: interviews on the free plan. They are 10-minute mini interviews.

billing_enabled.title: Billing Enabled
billing_enabled.description: False until Stripe keys are set.

PlanOut.title: PlanOut
PlanOut.description: The one paid plan. Every number comes from the API config.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: 1 is the first session to run.

flow.title: Flow
flow.description: cancel opens the portal at the cancellation step.

Principle.description:
One company value, for example 'Customer Obsession'. The name is its id in briefs and
scorecards, so keep it stable across profile versions.

evidence_signals.description: What evidence of this principle sounds like in an answer.
evidence_signals.title: Evidence Signals

weight.description: Relative weight of this value inside the values share.
weight.title: Weight

Principle.title: Principle

ProbeDecision.description:
What the interviewer model decides after an answer in CORE (IV-3).

A constrained choice, so a weak model cannot derail the session. The session controller
enforces the probe limit per question and moves on once it is reached, whatever this says.

missing.description: What the answer lacks; empty to move on.
missing.title: Missing

ProbeDecision.title: ProbeDecision

ProbeTrigger.description: IV-3 follow-up rules: what an answer lacks, so the interviewer probes.
ProbeTrigger.title: ProbeTrigger

ProfileField.description: Top-level profile fields that carry sources and a confidence level.
ProfileField.title: ProfileField

ProfileIn.title: ProfileIn
ProfileIn.description: AC-3: the profile asked for at the first sign-in. No payment details.

ProfileOut.title: ProfileOut
ProfileOut.description: AC-3. complete is false until the user saves the profile once.

ProgressSnapshot.title: ProgressSnapshot
ProgressSnapshot.description: One competency score from one Realistic session, for trend charts (PR-1).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Empty when accepted. Else a fixed sentence for the refusal, then the model's short reason when there is one.

competencies.title: Competencies
competencies.description: 1 to 3 competencies of `category` when accepted, else empty.

duplicate_of.title: Duplicate Of
duplicate_of.description: Index in `existing` of a near-duplicate (CU-5), else null. A flag only.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: An own question, or a free-text focus chip (CU-2).

category.description: The category the candidate chose. When set, it wins over the model's tag.

existing.title: Existing
existing.description: The other questions (or chips) already in the session, for the duplicate flag.

QuestionPattern.description: A recurring theme, phrased as a pattern. Never a leaked or NDA-protected question.

values.description: Principle names from values_framework this probes.
values.title: Values

QuestionPattern.title: QuestionPattern

QuestionRefusal.title: QuestionRefusal
QuestionRefusal.description: CU-5: why a candidate's own question or focus chip is refused.

QuestionSource.title: QuestionSource
QuestionSource.description: Who wrote a brief question: the planner, or the candidate in a Custom session (CU-3).

id.title: Id
id.description: The gap analysis id, or the session id of a debrief.

job_name.title: Job Name
job_name.description: None when the job description was deleted.

resume_id.title: Resume Id
resume_id.description: The CV used. None for debriefs of sessions from before PR-3 stored it.

resume_name.title: Resume Name
resume_name.description: None when there is no CV or it was deleted.

status.title: Status
status.description: Gap reports are always ready. A debrief is scoring, ready or failed.

at.title: At
at.description: When the report was made; the list is newest first.

ReportItem.title: ReportItem
ReportItem.description:
One row of the Reports page. Open a gap report with GET /gap-analyses/{id} and a debrief
with GET /sessions/{id}/debrief.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Resume text that supports the score.

id.description: The requirement id from the input, e.g. 'r3'.
id.title: Id

evidence.description: A short quote from the resume that supports the rating.
evidence.title: Evidence

Resume.title: Resume
Resume.description: A parsed resume (IN-3). Contact details are deliberately not part of the contract.

ResumeMatch.title: ResumeMatch
ResumeMatch.description: R1: the saved CV with the same file content, or None.

ResumeMatchIn.title: ResumeMatchIn
ResumeMatchIn.description: R1: the SHA-256 of a CV file (or of the pasted text as UTF-8) before it is uploaded.

name.title: Name
name.description: R1: the name in the CV library. None when the CV is deleted.

deleted.title: Deleted
deleted.description: R1: the CV was deleted. Its gap reports stay.

confirmed_at.title: Confirmed At
confirmed_at.description: When the user checked and saved the extracted CV (PUT /resumes/{id}). None: not confirmed yet. A gap analysis does not wait for it.

test_only.title: Test Only
test_only.description: Roles only the AI candidate (P13) uses

sim_max_live_sessions.title: Sim Max Live Sessions
sim_max_live_sessions.description: SM-3: a sim run does not start while this many real sessions are live. 0 turns the limit off.

RuntimeSettings.title: RuntimeSettings
RuntimeSettings.description: Every ops control with its type and default. Field names are the setting keys.

SampleQuestion.description:
A question the company or candidates published, paraphrased, with its source.
Never an NDA-protected question or copied paid content.

strong_answer.description: What a strong answer covers. Our own guidance, not a copied answer.
strong_answer.title: Strong Answer

values.description: Principle names from values_framework this probes.
values.title: Values

source_url.description: Public page that reports the question.
source_url.title: Source Url

SampleQuestion.title: SampleQuestion

bank_ref.title: Bank Ref
bank_ref.description: Question bank id when added from the bank.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: 3 to 5 sentences, like a debrief summary.

competency_scores.title: Competency Scores
competency_scores.description: Overall score per competency across the session.

value_scores.title: Value Scores
value_scores.description: Overall score per company value. Empty in generic mode.

scorer_model.title: Scorer Model
scorer_model.description: Gateway model alias, never a vendor id.

SessionChannel.title: SessionChannel
SessionChannel.description:
PL-7. How the candidate and the interviewer talk. Text runs the same controller and
interviewer logic with typed input. It is a dev flag; the simulated-candidate tests use it.

custom.description: CU-1: required for the Custom type, absent for the others.

SessionConfig.title: SessionConfig
SessionConfig.description: What the candidate picks before a session (journey 2, step 1).

resume_id.title: Resume Id
resume_id.description: PR-3: the CV used for the session. None for old sessions.

config.description: The setup. For a Custom session, `custom` holds the categories, focus chips and own questions (CU-1).

brief_ready.title: Brief Ready
brief_ready.description: True when the interviewer brief is built.

failure_reason.title: Failure Reason
failure_reason.description: Plain reason when the session failed before it started (status failed, never started), for example when the interview plan could not be built. Such a session is not billed and does not use a free interview. Null otherwise.

config.description: For a Custom session, `custom` holds its setup.

SessionSetup.title: SessionSetup
SessionSetup.description: CU-9: a setup to prefill, from an earlier session. Same fields as CreateSessionRequest.

value.title: Value
value.description: The new value; its type depends on the key (null clears)

age_confirmed.title: Age Confirmed
age_confirmed.description: The user confirmed they are 18 or older.

training_consent.title: Training Consent
training_consent.description: AC-2: off unless the user opts in.

SiteBanner.title: SiteBanner
SiteBanner.description: OC-4: a banner in the candidate app until `until`.

banner.description: OC-4: the active banner, None after `until`

signups_open.title: Signups Open
signups_open.description: OC-1: false while new accounts are refused

voice_sessions_open.title: Voice Sessions Open
voice_sessions_open.description: OC-2, OC-3: new voice sessions can start

text_sessions_open.title: Text Sessions Open
text_sessions_open.description: OC-2, OC-3: new text sessions can start

custom_interview_access.description: CU-11: everyone, or paid_only (free accounts see Custom locked)

SiteStatus.title: SiteStatus
SiteStatus.description: What the candidate app shows: the site banner and what is paused (OC-1 to OC-4).

fields.description: Which profile fields this source supports.
fields.title: Fields

SubscriptionStatus.title: SubscriptionStatus
SubscriptionStatus.description: Mirrors the Stripe subscription statuses we act on.

TextTurns.title: TextTurns
TextTurns.description: The interviewer's new turns, and whether the session has ended.

Turn.title: Turn
Turn.description: One utterance in the transcript. Text only; audio is never stored.

status.description: Stripe status; null if never paid.

free_interviews_total.title: Free Interviews Total
free_interviews_total.description: Free mini interviews for the account.

full_interviews_allowed.title: Full Interviews Allowed
full_interviews_allowed.description: True when 30 and 45 minute sessions may start (paid plan). Free accounts may start 10-minute mini interviews only.

block_code.title: Block Code
block_code.description: Why a new session is blocked. Null when it is allowed.

has_billing_account.title: Has Billing Account
has_billing_account.description: True when the Customer Portal can open.

UsageOut.title: UsageOut
UsageOut.description: BL-1 usage meter and BL-2 free interview, as the API counts them.

ValueScore.title: ValueScore
ValueScore.description: Score for one company value (Principle.name), same 1 to 4 rubric as competencies.

VoiceJoin.title: VoiceJoin
VoiceJoin.description: What the browser needs to join the interview room (P7, P10).
